title: Embodied AI Project Dashboard
subtitle: World models, self-improving agents, and five ongoing real-robot research projects

summary.focus: Research 主线包括 UMI World Model、Self-Improving Agents，以及真机组五个 ongoing 项目：DexGELLO、OmniEgo、TacPoseBench、Tactile ICL、Robot4Robot。
summary.progress: Real-Robot Part.pptx 的项目定义、硬件组合与一句话叙事已映射为五张独立 Research 卡；旧的 DexGELLO / Robot4Robot Survey 分类被当前项目规划取代。
summary.blockers: 五张卡片记录的是当前项目路线，不等于实机闭环已经完成。共同门槛仍是同步与标定、数据 schema、触觉质量、跨本体映射、guarded execution，以及可复现的 sim/real 评测。
summary.next: 为真机项目冻结第一版接口与验收证据；Tactile ICL 优先完成 Prompt Package v0、压力轨迹因果诊断和 mixed VTLA smoke checkpoint，再进入柔顺插接与线缆装配旗舰任务。

storyline.summary: How real-robot infra, human demonstrations, video world models, simulators, and physical outputs form one loop.

nodes.title: Real-Robot Data Infra
nodes.body: ARX, UMI, Cobot Magic, Linker hands, gloves, VIVE Tracker, and Franka + Wuji provide the hardware base for collection, calibration, and validation.

nodes.title: Video + HOI World Modeling
nodes.body: UMI wrist views, robot-head ego videos, layered manipulation state, same-task HOI data, and rate-curve teleop research turn human operation into structured video, inferred action, and state data.

nodes.title: Self-Improving Sim + Physical Products
nodes.body: Agentic Real2Sim2Real-VLA evaluation, generated assets, household tasks, simulator rollouts, robot evaluation, and language / image-to-CAD design close the loop back into real-world experiments.

flows.title: Five projects from data collection to cross-embodiment teaching

nodes.title: DexGELLO + OmniEgo
nodes.body: DexGELLO captures high-fidelity isomorphic arm-hand demonstrations; OmniEgo captures synchronized first-person, hand/tactile, gaze/face, audio and EMG data from natural human interaction.

nodes.title: Tactile ICL + TacPoseBench
nodes.body: Tactile ICL turns one tactile-rich DataClaw demonstration into a skill prompt; TacPoseBench trains PosePlan-VTLA to forecast future in-gripper SE(2) motion and generate closed-loop extrinsic-contact actions.

nodes.title: Robot4Robot
nodes.body: A privileged-perception teacher converts semantic scene, trajectory and contact knowledge into cross-embodiment supervision for a different learner robot.

flows.title: How Tri-View becomes layered robot data for IDM, reward, and adaptation

nodes.title: UMI Ego World
nodes.body: Generate synchronized action-conditioned robot videos from UMI wrist views plus fixed/floating robot-head ego context. This track owns WAN/Cosmos/Gamma baselines and robot-video galleries.

nodes.title: Robot Video Layers
nodes.body: Decompose real or generated robot videos into temporally consistent robot, object/contact, and background layers with masks, recomposition QA, and structured metadata.

nodes.title: Layered Data Utility
nodes.body: Robot layer feeds IDM / pose / VO, object layer feeds process reward and RL supervision, and background layer feeds RoboEngine-style adaptation. The ablation asks whether layered data beats flat RGB or masks alone.

visual_references.alt: UMI World Model layered preprocessing pipeline separating robot, object, and background layers with segmentation, inpainting, agent QA, and rigid versus deformable routing.
visual_references.caption: UMI layered preprocessing flow: remove the robot, recover object plus background with VACE, segment the object, validate inpainting and recognition with agents, then route rigid and deformable objects to separate downstream processing.

visual_references.alt: MolmoAct episode processing pipeline with RobotSeg, VACE, SAM3, bounded QA retries, completed and needs_review outcomes.
visual_references.caption: UMI / MolmoAct offline episode materialization: materialize both views, segment and QA robot/object/background layers, retry recoverable failures, and route unresolved uncertainty to needs_review.

visual_references.alt: Daniel Gehrig event-camera overview slide with standard camera and DVS outputs plus compact SynSense Speck hardware
visual_references.caption: Seminar framing: event cameras report scene-motion-induced brightness changes as sparse events; the compact Speck module illustrates the form-factor opportunity. Treat it as an auxiliary wrist or always-on sensor candidate, not an RGB substitute.

visual_references.alt: Standard RGB image beside positive and negative event measurements aggregated over 50 milliseconds
visual_references.caption: Events aggregated over 50 ms expose changing edges and polarity but omit full static appearance. This is why RGB-event fusion is the default architecture for VLA and world-model experiments.

visual_references.alt: Moving-object detection slide showing known robot ego-motion, observed events, and motion-compensated object segmentation
visual_references.caption: Moving cameras generate background events from ego-motion. Robot joint state and wrist-camera TF should condition motion compensation so residual event sharpness isolates independently moving objects and contacts.

visual_references.alt: Tactile-WAM video-to-touch world action model pipeline connecting human motion, robot video generation, tactile prediction, and executable actions.
visual_references.caption: Tactile-WAM proposal: retarget human motion into robot arm-hand video, predict contact, pressure, and slip from the rollout, then train a joint video-tactile world-action head that emits executable actions.

visual_references.alt: PhysX-Anything framework mapping an image prompt and structured physical representation into URDF or XML assets for simulation.
visual_references.caption: PhysX-Anything framework: extract scale, affordance, material, kinematics, description, and part geometry from an image, then decode the representation into URDF or XML for physical simulation.

visual_references.alt: PhysX-Anything controllable flow transformer and physical-format decoder architecture.
visual_references.caption: PhysX-Anything decoder: a controllable flow transformer predicts high-resolution geometry features, while a physical-format decoder emits mesh, radiance-field, 3D Gaussian, URDF, XML, and part-level outputs.

visual_references.alt: PhysX-Omni framework generating simulation-ready physical 3D assets for free-fall and wind-driven motion.
visual_references.caption: PhysX-Omni framework: convert object imagery into a structured, simulation-ready asset with overall and part geometry information, then exercise it under free-fall and wind-driven dynamics.

visual_references.alt: PhysX-Bench evaluation dimensions for geometry, description, affordance, material, kinematics, and absolute scale.
visual_references.caption: PhysX-Bench evaluates generated physical assets across geometry, semantic description, affordance, material behavior, kinematic coherence, and absolute scale.

visual_references.alt: RoboTwin 2.0 expert code generation and repair pipeline using task execution logs and VLM observations.
visual_references.caption: RoboTwin 2.0 expert-code loop: generate task programs from task/API context, execute repeated trials, classify failures from logs and visual observations, repair code, and retain programs that pass the success threshold.

visual_references.alt: Mechanoluminescent flexible tactile sensor design, CMOS readout mechanism, force image outputs, handwriting recognition, and Pac-Man and Minecraft interaction demonstrations
visual_references.caption: ML-sensor converts normal-force-induced mechanoluminescence into 640 x 480 CMOS tactile images; the corresponding paper was published in Advanced Science in 2026, so the slide footer saying submitted in 2025 is stale. Keep it as a vision-native tactile representation reference for VTAM, not as evidence of shear sensing or robot-policy gains.
visual_references.source: Daimon VTAM / Yu Feng et al., Advanced Science 2026

visual_references.alt: RoboTac Skin design comparing human skin receptors with a flexible ionic conductive film and FPCB electrode stack deployed on a robot gripper
visual_references.caption: The supplied 2025 RoboTac Skin slide proposes a thin ionic-conductive-film sandwich with FPCB and Au/Cu electrodes for conformable robot deployment; no public DOI, preprint, or project page was located in the 2026-07-17 audit. Keep it as sensor-stack and deployment context, not peer-reviewed performance or policy evidence.
visual_references.source: Daimon VTAM / user-provided research presentation capture

visual_references.alt: Ther-Tac active thermal tactile sensor design, pulse-heating and cooling mechanism, material response curves, clustering, and robot material-identification validation
visual_references.caption: The supplied Ther-Tac slide describes pulse heating plus transient cooling for effusivity-based in-grasp material identification and labels the work under review in 2025; no public DOI, preprint, or project page was located in the 2026-07-17 audit. Its durable value is a nonvisual material-identity channel, not evidence of force control or action learning.
visual_references.source: Daimon VTAM / user-provided research presentation capture

visual_references.alt: MC-Tac magnetic tactile prototype contact-response traces for x, y, and z interactions and a robot ring-placement task
visual_references.caption: The supplied MC-Tac slide shows Bx/By/Bz response traces under x/y/z contact and a robot ring-placement demonstration. Targeted search found no matching public paper record as of 2026-07-18; the published 2023 MC-Tac is a different camera-based modular sensor. Keep this single task-level slide as an in-progress magnetic-contact-sensor reference, not peer-reviewed performance evidence.
visual_references.source: Daimon VTAM / user-provided research presentation capture

visual_references.alt: Robot4Robot pipeline combining multi-view RGB-D, point clouds, robot state, end-effector trajectories, and contact information into a semantic 3D scene model for an embodied learner and robot teacher.
visual_references.caption: R4R-01：把多视角 RGB-D、点云、机器人状态、末端轨迹与接触信息融合为动态语义 3D 场景模型，为场景理解、状态诊断、风险反馈与教师接口提供训练期特权信息。

visual_references.alt: Robot4Robot research overview linking privileged visual sensing, an intelligent teacher robot, an embodied learner, and iterative learning.
visual_references.caption: Robot4Robot 总览：PPS 提供全局观测，教师机器人负责示范与必要干预，本体学习者通过交互数据持续迭代。

visual_references.alt: Robot4Robot Phase I with PPS scene reconstruction, supervision, diagnosis, demonstrations, interventions, and an ego-only learner.
visual_references.caption: Phase I：PPS 用场景重建、物体轨迹与任务状态提供监督、诊断、示范和必要干预；部署端仍只使用本体感知。

visual_references.alt: Cross-view privileged distillation from synchronized multi-camera RGB-D and scene state into a deployable first-person student.
visual_references.caption: R4R-02：把训练期多源视觉、3D 状态与表征、价值、奖励和策略监督，经跨视角与时间对齐蒸馏到可部署的第一视角 Student。

visual_references.alt: Robot4Robot Phase II combining PPS global observation with a privileged teacher robot and an ego-only learner.
visual_references.caption: Phase II：在 PPS 全局观测之上加入特权教师机器人，通过任务示范和必要干预形成跨本体教学闭环。

visual_references.alt: Active robot teacher selecting observe, hint, demonstrate, correct, intervene, or stay silent from learner ability, uncertainty, task stage, and risk.
visual_references.caption: R4R-03：Teacher 根据学习者能力、不确定性、任务阶段和风险，主动选择观察、提示、示范、纠正、介入或保持沉默。

visual_references.alt: Privileged teaching system turning real-world execution and failures into diagnosis, demonstrations, interventions, multilevel supervision, and policy updates.
visual_references.caption: R4R-04：把特权学习从被动 Oracle 蒸馏扩展为主动具身教学，把真实执行与失败持续转成诊断、示范、干预和多层监督。

visual_references.alt: Dual-Sim architecture with trainable masked attention over initial-frame, embodiment, action-state, and fixed multi-view simulation-video tokens
visual_references.caption: Dual-Sim 路线 A：EasyControl-style DiT 通过非对称 Attention Mask 隔离背景与仿真条件；本体 token 可读取多视角 sim-video 的几何和运动先验，背景 token 不能读取，sim token 始终是只读固定条件。

visual_references.alt: Training-free timestep-adaptive sim-motion guidance using a frozen GE-Sim V2 world model and motion-representation energy
visual_references.caption: Dual-Sim 路线 B1：冻结 GE-Sim V2，用时间差分与空间低通构造运动表征，在去噪时最小化真实预测与 sim-video 的运动能量差；引导强度按时间步先升高、中段维持、后段衰减。

visual_references.alt: Training-free robot-region sim-latent guidance using a robot mask and timestep-adaptive denoising schedule
visual_references.caption: Dual-Sim 路线 B2：冻结基础 World Model，仅在机器人 mask 内把预测 clean latent 对齐到 sim latent；前期约束结构与运动，后期降低 guidance，让基础模型恢复真实材质、光照和交互细节。

visual_references.alt: Whiteboard diagram mapping UMI Stage 1 VM prediction, independent IDM action recovery, DM action-conditioned correction, and Action Forcing.
visual_references.caption: UMI Stage 1 结构映射：共享视频主干以 VM/Predictor 模式从观测与任务条件提出未来，以 DM/Simulator 模式从观测与动作生成受约束未来；独立 IDM 从视觉转移恢复动作。Action Forcing 用 VM → IDM → DM 循环约束物理一致性。概念图不代表各模块已训练完成。
visual_references.source: UMI Image Layered World Model / user-provided whiteboard

visual_references.alt: Agentic System 2 board for embodied cooking showing stable tool contracts, VLA and analytic control options, deployment perturbations, shared world state, a planner, skill interface, and embodied execution.
visual_references.caption: Self-Improving Agents 架构启发：Harness 维护可信 world state，System 2 负责长时规划与失败恢复，并通过稳定 Tool/Skill contract 调用解析 primitive、contact-rich controller、VLA/WAM 或 simulator。每次调用必须返回 ToolResult、state delta、diagnostics、trusted receipt 与 fresh observation，才能形成可回放、可诊断、可晋升的闭环。
visual_references.source: Self-Improving Agents / user-provided Agentic Robotics board

visual_references.alt: Comparison table of CaP-X, Guava, ENPIRE, ASPIRE, Harness VLA, Thea, and OpenETA across tool contracts, observations, planners, control backends, VLA dependence, and returned execution evidence.
visual_references.caption: Self-Improving Agents 对照框架：不要只比较是否使用 VLA；应同时比较 Tool contract、observation/state surface、planner/controller stack、VLA dependence，以及 primitive 执行后是否返回 post-condition、fresh observation、diagnostics、trace 与 trusted receipt。该表是架构研究语境，不是已核验的横向 benchmark 结果。
visual_references.source: Self-Improving Agents / user-provided harness comparison board

visual_references.alt: Action Forcing diagram showing a current observation, VM future prediction, independent IDM action recovery, DM correction, and a cycle loss.
visual_references.caption: UMI Stage 1 的功能双模式对应图中的 VM 与 DM：VM/Predictor 先想象 O_hat_{t+1}，外部 IDM 反推动作 a_hat_t，DM/Simulator 再以该动作生成或修正下一观测；Action Forcing 对循环一致性施加约束。双模式共享视频主干，IDM 保持独立。
visual_references.source: UMI Image Layered World Model / user-provided Action Forcing diagram

visual_references.alt: Chinese explanatory excerpt about long-horizon physical hallucination and Action Forcing with inverse dynamics and physical constraints.
visual_references.caption: 物理幻觉来自长链预测误差累积；UMI 的应对不是让世界模型直接输出动作，而是用独立 IDM 把视觉转移还原为动作，再让 DM/Simulator 检查动作条件下的未来是否一致。该文字仅用于问题与方法叙事，不作为 Poke 或 UMI 实验结果证据。
visual_references.source: UMI Image Layered World Model / user-provided Action Forcing explainer

visual_references.alt: Dual-Sim dual-simulation architecture with a physics simulator producing kinematic trajectory, unified robot-motion video, and proprioception for a photorealistic world-model simulator.
visual_references.caption: Dual-Sim 总架构：Physics Simulator 负责不同本体的运动学/动力学，并输出运动学轨迹、统一 robot-motion video 与 proprioception；World-Model Simulator 结合初始图像/状态生成真实感未来视频和未来机器人状态。它提出了跨本体统一输入与 VLA 闭环核验接口，但图中能力仍需实验验证。

visual_references.alt: Dual-Sim trainable Sim Context Tower using a frozen VAE, sim-only LoRA, zero-initialized projections, and pixel-aligned residual injection into a frozen GE-Sim V2 Video DiT.
visual_references.caption: Dual-Sim 可训练 adapter 路线：simulator video 经 Frozen VAE 与 Sim Context Tower 编码；共享冻结 block 权重，只训练 sim-only LoRA，并通过 zero-init projection 在多层向冻结的 GE-Sim V2 Video DiT 注入 pixel-aligned residual。原始 27-channel 输入路径保持不变；该图是实现方案，不代表训练或质量门已经通过。
visual_references.source: Dual-Sim / user-provided Sim Context Tower diagram

weekly_briefs.title: Tri-View Ego World + IDM overall proposal
weekly_briefs.summary: Rewrote Tri-View as a two-stage Ego World + IDM foundation-model proposal; 2026-06-21 update backs up the MaskWAM vs UMI memo and folds the SAM3/VLM/human-verification mask pipeline into the global layered dataset selection gate.

projects.title: UMI Image Layered World Model
projects.summary: UMI World Model is a three-paper program with one shared data substrate: Stage 1 trains a streaming multi-view pose/action-conditioned robot world model and now owns the URDF/FK/action/camera Robot Layer branch; Stage 2 turns manipulation videos into reusable scene, object/contact, occluder/tool, and robot/actor layers; Stage 3 tests whether those layers improve manipulation and video-model training. This intro is architecture/status framing only; execution lives in TODOs and task comments.

projects.title: DexTTT: Test-Time Training for Dexterous Arm-Hand Policies
projects.summary: DexTTT combines a factorized 54D arm-hand policy, FoundationPose-conditioned Value/Q learning, targeted human intervention, and guarded test-time updates on Dual Franka + Dual Wuji.

projects.title: ActiveDex: Environment-Aware Active Vision for Mobile Dexterous Manipulation
projects.summary: ActiveDex jointly predicts differential-base, arm, and AmazingHand actions on XLeRobot. Environment memory and task-aware View Value turn base motion into an active sensing and manipulation capability for occluded retrieval, drawer search, and mobile handover.

projects.title: EgoSensorium / EgoSuperMimic: Human Demonstrations to Dexterous Manipulation
projects.summary: 同一研究母项目下的两个子项目：EgoSensorium 构建同步多模态穿戴式数采系统、数据集和主动采集反馈；EgoSuperMimic 将 ego 视频中的手物交互转成机器人可执行的双手工具操作，研究 SuperMimic 式世界模型训练、接触切换与长程衔接。两者通过带时间、坐标、接触和置信度的 demonstration manifest 连接，分别验收数据质量与机器人执行效果。

projects.title: TacPoseBench: Future In-Gripper Pose Planning for Extrinsic Dexterity
projects.summary: TacPoseBench 研究机器人抓住物体后如何把它调整到任务所需姿态。Tac2Pose Teacher 离线为真实触觉示范生成带置信度的 SE(2) pose sequence，并构造未来夹爪内位姿轨迹监督；PosePlan-VTLA 同时预测 Future SE(2) Pose Plan 与双臂 action chunk。策略通过桌面、桌沿、墙面、固定结构、其他物体或另一只机械手产生 extrinsic contact，在短时执行后读取新触觉并重新规划。Benchmark 统一评测 Future Pose Forecasting、Goal-Conditioned Regulation、Contact Generalization 与 Downstream Utility。
